question: Find the volume of a hemisphere of radius 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the hemisphere is 21 cm

**Formula used:**

volume of hemisphere=** **​​​​(2)/(3)× pi× r³​​​​​​

**Calculation:**

The radius of the hemisphere=21cm

The volume of hemisphere,

⇒ (2)/(3)× pi× r³

⇒ (2)/(3)× (22)/(7)× 21× 21× 21

⇒ 2 × 22 × 3 × 7 × 21

⇒ 19404 cm³

**The volume of the hemisphere is **19404 cm3.
